## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Kissimmee, United States. It starts at 7007 Sea World Drive.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Make the most of your time at SeaWorld Orlando by combining up-close animal interactions with thrilling rollercoasters and one-of-a-kind attractions. The unmissable MAKO is Orlando’s tallest, fastest, and longest coaster, and if you're into futurism, hit up the all-new Kraken Unleashed Virtual Reality (VR) coaster. And nobody visits SeaWorld without witnessing the power and grace of the famous orcas!
